ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite and aerial monitoring system designed to track urban heat islands and industrial compliance across Los Angeles County.
ideas.title: AeroSentinel LA
ideas.why_it_could_win: It leverages the hard engineering pattern seen in past geospatial winners like GeoNex-ATLAS, offering judges a tangible environmental impact angle suited for Los Angeles.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video intelligence platform tailored for local production houses to instantly index, search, and analyze raw B-roll and script alignment.
ideas.title: CineSearch LA
ideas.why_it_could_win: It mimics the winning formula of LibrAI by turning unstructured video data into actionable searchable databases, appealing directly to the local entertainment hub of Los Angeles.

ideas.pitch: An automated risk forecasting and incident detection engine designed to predict supply chain disruptions across West Coast shipping ports.
ideas.title: PacificRisk AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: It adapts the rigorous predictive modeling and Poisson regression techniques seen in the Apart Research AI Forecasting winner to a high-value logistics problem.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven patient acquisition and trust engine specifically built for specialized cosmetic and dental clinics in Southern California.
ideas.title: MediTrust LA
ideas.why_it_could_win: It applies the rapid sprint success of Global-Smile, delivering immediate, measurable business conversion value that hackathon judges and local founders love.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace with smart contract escrow payments tailored for freelance creative services in the Los Angeles gig economy.
ideas.title: AgenticEscrow LA
ideas.why_it_could_win: It incorporates the proven architecture of Dispatch, combining agentic workflows with secure escrow transactions to deliver a complete product within 30 hours.
